# Entry-Level Data Analyst Cover Letter for a Berlin Startup

## Tailored Cover Letter
Subject: Application for Entry-Level Data Analyst Role

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Entry-Level Data Analyst role at your Berlin startup. With one year of internship experience and hands-on skills in Excel, SQL, and basic Python, I have developed a strong foundation in turning data into clear, useful insights.

During my internship, I supported reporting and analysis tasks that required accuracy, organization, and careful attention to detail. I learned how to clean data, spot inconsistencies, and present findings in a way that helped others make better decisions. I also enjoy solving problems by asking the right questions, testing approaches, and improving processes step by step.

What attracts me most to a startup environment is the opportunity to learn quickly, take ownership, and contribute across different areas. I am comfortable working in fast-moving teams, adapting to new tools, and building my skills through feedback and collaboration.

I would welcome the chance to bring my analytical mindset, reliability, and eagerness to learn to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
